name: one sentence becomes a checklist
looks: A plain-language instruction types into a single input field and the submit arrow presses down. A panel opens beneath the input and a short checklist builds top to bottom, one line per beat, each landing with a green check and a couple of small chips naming what it picked.
build: Input text revealed with kit.typeOn; submit scale 1 -> 0.88 -> 1 on power3.out; checklist lines fade/rise in top to bottom on an uneven stagger, each getting a check-mark pop and optional trailing chips.
sound: A soft key tick per character, a click on submit, then a light tick per checklist line landing.
prompt: Type one plain-language instruction into a single input and press submit, then let a short checklist build underneath it top to bottom, one line per beat, each line landing with a check mark and a couple of small chips naming exactly what was understood. Keep the instruction and the picks generic, not a real brand's data.
